portfolio.statement: Nippon India Overnight Fund maintains an asset base heavily concentrated in reverse repo and repo instruments, supplemented by short-dated sovereign securities.
interp: The portfolio holds 90.11% across Reverse Repo and Repo instruments, establishing an overwhelmingly cash-equivalent profile.
Direct sovereign instruments, including Treasury Bills and a Central Government Loan maturing in November 2026, account for 5.97% of the portfolio.
portfolio.line: Predominantly allocated to reverse repo alongside short-dated government securities.

drivers.text: Reverse Repo constitutes 89.57% of the fund's total portfolio assets as of October 31, 2026.
Treasury Bills and Central Government Loans maturing in November 2026 collectively make up 5.97% of holdings.

portfolio.risk_note: The fund's asset profile is largely subject to overnight lending conditions given the 89.57% concentration in Reverse Repo.
